Let \(f(n)=\frac{n^2}{1.001^n}\). Then

\[
\frac{f(n+1)}{f(n)}
=
\frac{(n+1)^2}{n^2}\cdot \frac{1}{1.001}
=
\frac{(1+\frac1n)^2}{1.001}.
\]

The sequence increases when

\[
\frac{f(n+1)}{f(n)}>1
\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
\left(1+\frac1n\right)^2>1.001.
\]

This holds for \(n\le 2000\), since

\[
\left(\frac{2001}{2000}\right)^2 = \frac{4{,}004{,}001}{4{,}000{,}000} > 1.001.
\]

It decreases for \(n\ge 2001\), since

\[
\left(\frac{2002}{2001}\right)^2 = \frac{4{,}008{,}004}{4{,}004{,}001} < 1.001.
\]

Thus the maximum occurs at \(n=2001\).

\[
\boxed{2001}
\]
